name: Kasun Senanayake
tagline: Capturing Timeless Stories Across Sri Lanka & Beyond
bio: I am a dedicated fine art and wedding photographer with over 12 years of experience documenting intimate love stories, cultural celebrations, and evocative portraits across Colombo, Kandy, Galle, and the hill country of Sri Lanka.
style: My photography blends warm natural light, candid emotions, and an editorial touch rooted in timeless aesthetics.
